name: STICKEE | Zepplin | 1G | Live Resin Concentrate
description: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ ". . . the Zeppelin had me writing poetry about Doritos.” The Zeppelin is not just a name...it’s a flight plan. This sativa doesn’t creep; it launches you like classic rock blasting from a hot air balloon sponsored by Red Bull. The science is simple: we harvested terpenes so citrusy, piney, and uplifting that Isaac Newton himself would’ve taken a rip and discovered gravity twice. Flavor? Bright lemon, sharp diesel, and enough sweetness to keep your taste buds singing “Stairway to Heaven.” The high is euphoric, heady, and designed for creativity binges that start with painting and end with you inventing a new form of jazz. Buy The Zeppelin because why walk when you can fly at 30,000 feet with a grin plastered across your face?
